S003.examples: Appears not to be listening, looking elsewhere or spacing out during conversation.

S005.name: Organization_Difficulty
S005.description: Often has difficulty organizing tasks and activities.
S005.examples: Desk, bag, or room is always messy and remains disorganized.

S007.name: Losing_Items
S007.description: Often loses things necessary for tasks or activities.
S007.examples: Loses necessary documents or materials at home or in the office and cannot find them.

S008.name: Distractibility
S008.description: Often easily distracted by extraneous stimuli (for older adolescents and adults, may include unrelated thoughts).
S008.examples: Loses focus and listens in when hearing side conversations or TV sounds.

S012.name: Feeling_Restless
S012.description: Often runs about or climbs in situations where it is inappropriate. (Note: In adolescents or adults, may be limited to feeling restless.)
S012.examples: A sense of urgency and anxiety that one must keep moving or doing something.

S013.name: Quiet_Activity_Difficulty
S013.description: Often unable to play or engage in leisure activities quietly.
S013.examples: Cannot endure and avoids quiet and calm activities like meditation or yoga.

S001.name: Detail_Inattention_Errors
S001.description: Often fails to give close attention to details or makes careless mistakes.
S001.examples: Frequently omits details or makes typos in work documents or reports.

S003.name: Listening_Difficulty
S003.description: Often does not seem to listen when spoken to directly.
S003.examples: Does not respond when name is called or answers only after a long delay.

S005.name: Organization_Difficulty
S005.description: Often has difficulty organizing tasks and activities.
S005.examples: Fails to plan time effectively, frequently missing deadlines or rushing to finish at the last minute.

S007.name: Losing_Items
S007.description: Often loses things necessary for tasks or activities.
S007.examples: Frequently loses school supplies or office supplies like pens, erasers, and calculators.

S008.name: Distractibility
S008.description: Often easily distracted by extraneous stimuli (for older adolescents and adults, may include unrelated thoughts).
S008.examples: Easily distracted and stops working due to small noises or movements nearby.

S012.name: Feeling_Restless
S012.description: Often runs about or climbs in situations where it is inappropriate. (Note: In adolescents or adults, may be limited to feeling restless.)
S012.examples: Feels unable to endure staying still and must constantly be doing something.

S013.name: Quiet_Activity_Difficulty
S013.description: Often unable to play or engage in leisure activities quietly.
S013.examples: Cannot play quietly, often shouting or making loud noises during games or play.
